description: Client-side script for 'Payment Order' form in ERPNext, handling form setup, refresh, row removal, button actions, and payment record creation.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
classes.description: UI dialog component used for input collection in payment record creation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Payment Order form, setting query filters and properties.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adds buttons based on document status and type.

methods.name: remove_row_if_empty
methods.description: Removes references row if the first row is empty.

methods.name: remove_button
methods.description: Removes specific custom buttons based on payment order type.

methods.name: get_from_payment_entry
methods.description: Maps data from Payment Entry to Payment Order.

methods.name: get_from_payment_request
methods.description: Maps data from Payment Request to Payment Order.

methods.name: make_payment_records
methods.description: Creates payment records via a dialog for supplier and mode of payment.
